instruction.text: Choose which idiom can be used here.

atoms.a: I'm not sure whether I should go to Laura's party tonight.
atoms.b: I'm ((++on_the_fence_about wrapping_my_head_around)) going to Laura's party tonight.

atoms.a: I think we should leave it be for today.
I'm not sure if we still have any pasta left, but let's start anyway. If not, we'll figure out what to do once we're done with the sauce.
atoms.b: I'm not sure if we still have any pasta left, but we'll ((++_cross_that_bridge_when_we_come_to_it call_it_a_day)).

atoms.a: By taking the overnight train to Stockholm I can travel and get a good night's sleep at the same time!
atoms.b: By taking the overnight train to Stockholm I can ((++kill_two_birds_with_one_stone hit_the_nail_on_the_head)).

atoms.a: Ana won't join us today because she isn't feeling well.
atoms.b: Ana won't join us today because she is ((++feeling_under_the_weather on_the_fence_about_it)).

atoms.a: This new job opportunity was really unexpected.
atoms.b: This new job opportunity really ((++came_out_of_the_blue addressed_the_elephant_in_the_room)).

atoms.a: I believe the presentation about time zones will be boring but we should not judge too quickly.
atoms.b: I believe the presentation about time zones  will be boring but you should never ((++judge_a_book_by_its_cover add_insult_to_injury)).
